candidates.change_summary: Change pot += msg.value to pot += msg.value - FEE_AMOUNT so pot accumulates less, altering final pot balance.
Change pot = 0 to pot = 1 so that after a win the pot is not fully reset.
Delete pot = 0 so the pot is never reset after a win, accumulating value across plays.
Change pot += msg.value to pot = 0 so the pot never accumulates bets.
Change require(msg.value == TICKET_AMOUNT) to require(msg.value == 0) altering who can play and pot accumulation.
Replace 'pot += msg.value;' with 'pot += 0;' so pot never increases.
Replace 'pot += msg.value;' with 'pot += msg.value + 1;' so pot becomes 11 instead of 10.
Replace 'payable(bank).transfer(FEE_AMOUNT);' with 'payable(msg.sender).transfer(FEE_AMOUNT);' so the fee goes to the player instead of the bank.
Replace 'payable(msg.sender).transfer(pot - FEE_AMOUNT);' with 'payable(msg.sender).transfer(pot);' so the player receives the full pot without deducting the fee.
Replace 'pot = 0;' with 'pot = 1;' so pot is not reset to zero after a win.
Delete 'pot = 0;' so pot retains its value after a win, affecting subsequent play outcomes.
Replace 'if (random == 0)' with 'if (random == 1)' inverting the win condition.
Replace 'uint random = uint(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.timestamp, block.difficulty))) % 2;' with 'uint random = 0;' so the player always wins.
